question: What imperishable great fortune is she, in what god-forms, by own self?
premises: vishnu-and-rest formedness in god, which, some, she by own self
inference: She is bhoga-moksha-freedom Mahalakshmi, Vishnu-formed by own self.
plain_english: She, enjoyment-liberation-freedom great-fortune, here imperishable — Vishnu-and-rest formedness in god, which, some, she by own self.
